summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd., a foreign private issuer, announcing the timing of its first quarter 2026 earnings release and conference call scheduled for May 13, 2026. The filing includes only a press release with standard earnings date notice, dial-in details, and webcast links. No special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change is mentioned. As a non-US filing, this 6-K serves as the equivalent of a routine earnings announcement notice. The disclosure contains no deal terms, financial metrics, or structural mechanics. There is no event to analyze as a special situation.
